result.notes:
No code change in this round. The red V1 came from AICORE_ROOT pointing to a frozen aicore snapshot without aicore.util.redact. AICORE_ROOT now points to the clone's packages/aicore (which has redact.py), and python3 scripts/affected-tests.py --run --no-cache exits 0: bridges, aicore, brain, harness, orch, planner, skiller and the hub checks (ecosystem-units, public-hygiene, golden) are all green. The piece itself is as described in the previous report: aicore.util.redact (redact_text, redact_document, env_secrets), delegation from aicore.ext.process (mask *** kept, no patterns), redaction in orch progress lines, role failure detail and stderr tail, orch.* event data and the observer report; T7 leak tests in packages/orch/tests/test_redaction.py and packages/aicore/tests/util/test_redact.py; doctor already warns about a non-ignored .swissknifeman/state/ (orch.conductor-gitignore).
Changed: CHANGELOG.md, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/ext/process.py, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/util/redact.py, packages/aicore/tests/util/test_redact.py, packages/orch/docs/events.md, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/observer.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/process.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/progress.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/events.py, packages/orch/tests/test_redaction.py

deviations: The earlier red V1 was an environment problem: AICORE_ROOT pointed to a frozen aicore snapshot that predates aicore.util.redact. orch now needs aicore with aicore.util.redact, so any environment that runs orch tests or code with an older aicore breaks at import.
